items_all.title: GPT-6.2 Astra solved a math theorem no other AI could crack, then invented its own proof strategy
items_all.summary: OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra independently produced a machine-verifiable Lean proof of Smoktunowicz's gap theorem, the first of its kind according to Vals AI. The model chose its own approach because key foundations were missing from Mathlib. On Autoform-Hard, Astra now leads the leaderboard with 49 of 56 tasks solved. The article GPT-6.2 Astra solved a math theorem no other AI could crack, then invented its own proof strategy appeared first on The Decoder .

items_all.title: AI推論供應鏈傳出提示詞外洩，OpenRouter停用3家供應商的服務
items_all.summary: 企業使用AI模型時，送出的提示詞可能經過第三方推論服務供應商處理，一旦供應商遭入侵，提示詞及其中的敏感資訊就可能外洩。工控資安業者Dragos最近公佈研究結果，指出研究團隊利用近200萬筆測試提示詞，發現至少3家AI推論服務供應商遭入侵，其中一起事件的攻擊者甚至取得AWS測試金鑰，並嘗試存取雲端服務。

items_all.title: Fortinet警告AI代理恐成駭客攻擊新目標，提示詞注入可誘使越權操作、誤導SOC事件判斷
items_all.summary: 網路安全業者Fortinet發布2027年資安威脅預測報告，指出隨著企業擴大使用AI代理，駭客可能更積極利用提示詞注入攻擊，誘使AI代理利用原有的存取權限，執行未經授權的操作。其他值得關注的威脅還包括企業付費AI服務遭盜用、AI與自動化工具加快漏洞攻擊準備，以及資安營運中心（SOC）的AI分析系統受到惡意資料誤導。

items_all.title: 微軟揭露GitHub Copilot CLI釣魚攻擊風險，駭客恐藉合法登入程序操控AI代理
items_all.summary: 駭客不必竊取帳號密碼，也可能利用合法的裝置驗證碼登入機制，誘騙開發者核准登入要求，藉此取得OAuth存取權杖。微軟研究發現，這類釣魚攻擊不只可能造成開發資料外洩，在特定條件下，還可能讓攻擊者遠端操控AI代理，在使用者電腦上執行命令。

items_all.title: COP31未達共識，環境部：加速推動AI成為減碳與氣候調適的新工具
items_all.summary: 聯合國氣候變化綱要公約第31屆締約方大會（COP31）結束後，環境部指出，雖然各國對部分氣候議題仍存在歧見，但全球氣候治理正逐步從國際協商轉向具體行動。對臺灣而言，後續重點除了持續推動減碳政策，也必須回應能源轉型、數位化與AI快速發展所帶來的新挑戰。 其中，AI在今年COP31會議的氣候治理議題逐漸受到重視。過去AI發展經常被視為增加能源需求的新來源，尤其大型模型訓練與推論需要大量運算資源，也帶動資料中心用電成長，全球大舉投入AI資料中心建設，AI資料中心的用電、用水等資源消耗，也引發AIDC的反對聲浪，政府單位先後暫時中止或審慎評估AIDC建置案。

items_all.title: 荷蘭測試6款AI眼鏡揭安全漏洞，建議消費者不要購買

items_all.title: Mira Murati 團隊把模型“想三遍再說話”開源了：26.4B 循環 Transformer 登頂 Hugging Face，筆記本就能跑
items_all.summary: Mira Murati 的 Thinking Machines Lab 發佈開源權重模型 Inkling2Mini，採用循環 Transformer：24層中，中間12層對每個 token 循環三次，首尾各六層只跑一次。該設計讓模型不生成更多文本也能延長“內部思考”，用更少 token 想清答案，即“多想少說”。此前同系列 Inkling2Small 因 594B 參數被嫌太大。

items_all.title: 把“增長優先”告上法庭：加州總檢察長起訴 OpenAI
items_all.summary: 加州總檢察長羅布·邦塔確認，已於11月16日正式起訴OpenAI，指控其未能確保AI模型安全，將公衆置於風險之中。邦塔在每週通訊中稱，“增長和速度壓倒了安全”，OpenAI把增長與速度置於安全之上，忽視危險信號，未確保模型安全。路透社報道了上述消息。

items_all.title: 說不清的症狀，拍給 AI 看：螞蟻阿福升級實時視頻問診
items_all.summary: 11月23日，螞蟻阿福醫療健康生態大會上，阿福App宣佈升級，基於百靈醫療健康系列模型，主打實時視頻“望聞問切”和全家健康檔案集中管理。用戶可在首頁右下角打開實時音視頻，將鏡頭對準皮膚變化或不適位置，健康排查從打字變爲當面聊，解決“身體不對勁卻說不清”的困擾，讓健康諮詢更直觀。

items_all.title: GLM-5.4 悄然上線 Coding Plan：補齊視覺能力，額度還漲了 1.5 倍
items_all.summary: 智譜GLM-5.4未辦發佈會便上線Coding Plan。官方運營稱，用戶將模型名設爲glm-5.4即可調用，V2、V3及團隊版額度同步提升至1.5倍。新模型詳情暫未公佈，但模型列表已出現“1M”和“視覺”標籤。官方預告顯示，其新增視覺能力，另一項新能力尚未完整披露。此舉被視爲搶先入場。

items_all.title: “歐洲版 OpenAI”落子新加坡：Mistral AI 設亞太總部，替亞洲政府造“主權 AI”
items_all.summary: 法國AI企業Mistral AI宣佈在新加坡設立亞太總部，作爲亞洲根據地。計劃到2027年區域員工擴至200人以上，招募科研、工程、AI及機器人人才。新辦公室以“擴展科學中心”形態運營，核心是爲政府機構和工業客戶開發定製AI模型，聚焦公共部門、高科技製造和機器人三大領域。

items_all.title: 萬億市值換不來投資級：Anthropic 發債大概率是垃圾級
items_all.summary: Anthropic獲股市熱捧，上週募資超1000億美元，估值約1.18萬億美元，超沃爾瑪和摩根大通；但其承諾未來數年投入約9000億美元採購算力，債券市場並不買賬。華爾街預期其債券將定爲垃圾級，評級大概率在BB區間，距投資級差一到兩檔。若成真，它將成爲美國市值最高的高收益債主體，凸顯股債市場分歧。

items_all.title: 螞蟻百靈醫療健康大模型家族全面開源：四款模型各守一關，從看懂體檢報告到攔住醫療風險
items_all.summary: 螞蟻百靈醫療健康大模型家族在螞蟻阿福醫療健康生態大會上宣佈全面開源，一次發佈四款模型：LingSante-3.1-air-VL、LingSante-3.1-flash、LingSante Pulse和LingSante MedGuard，分別覆蓋多模態健康信息理解、複雜醫學推理、健康預測與醫療安全防護。其中air-VL最貼近普通人，支持文字、圖片和視頻理解，可結合皮膚照片、飲食圖片、體檢報告進行綜合分析。

items_all.title: 調用量霸榜三十週，賺錢還差一關：國產模型的兩張榜單
items_all.summary: OpenRouter 11月16至22日周榜顯示，全球大模型總調用量210萬億Token，環比增8.25%；中國模型處理量連續30周居首，但支出榜仍由海外模型主導。流量榜前九中國廠商佔六席，DeepSeek、智譜、騰訊包攬前四：DeepSeek V4.1-Flash-1017以65萬億Token連續五週第一，V4.1 Flash、GLM 5.3 Flash、混元Hy4 flash分列二至四。

items_all.title: 一個 Slack 線程裏的數學震動：OpenAI 想給 AI 開發裝上限速器
items_all.summary: OpenAI首席科學家雅庫布·帕霍茨基認爲，大模型本質是壓縮器：先建大算力，在無結構數據上訓練壓縮器，再以提示、微調、強化學習激發潛力。衡量進步的核心指標仍是困惑度——預測下一個token的準確度，越低越準。11月22日他發文主張，用這一指標爲前沿模型開發設一道可覈驗的“限速線”。

items_all.title: 和 AI 視頻通話問診：螞蟻阿福用戶破 1.5 億，還要往手上戴
items_all.summary: 健康管理正從“治病”轉向“防病”。在廣州舉行的2026螞蟻阿福醫療健康生態大會上，螞蟻CEO韓歆毅判斷：AI對健康最深遠的價值是讓人少生病、少生大病；社會對AI賦能醫療關注多，對AI促進健康的投入明顯不足。上線一年多的螞蟻阿福已是全球最大AI健康應用，麥肯錫測算，若影響健康的因素得到充分管理，將釋放巨大健康價值。

items_all.title: 只給一下午寫代碼，交 PPT 反而能拿獎：AI 黑客鬆正在變味
items_all.summary: 從1999年OpenBSD黑客鬆用一週集成IPv6，到如今國內一年數百場AI黑客鬆，開發時間被壓縮至一下午。不少參賽者拿不出交付物，僅憑概念PPT也能獲獎，被直言是“PPT創意大賽”。賽場還成社交與路演場：選手混圈、帶成品拉投，投資人“白嫖”，呈現一幅錯位圖景。

items_all.title: 38 萬參數的 Transformer 塞進一張軟盤：三十年前的 486 老電腦，如今也能“跑 AI”
items_all.summary: 開發者WollyMonjac打造復古項目Tiny2.1，把微型問答Transformer塞進軟盤，讓運行DOS的486DX和Pentium老電腦也能用AI。該軟件用Turbo C 2.0編寫，雖非大型語言模型，卻與當今大模型架構同源，只是被極度壓縮。文中還提到，壓縮難點源於軟盤極其有限的容量。

items_all.title: 沉寂百日後先上前菜：智譜下週發 GLM-5.4，3 萬億旗艦 12 月見
items_all.summary: 國產大模型沉寂三個多月後，智譜被指下週發佈GLM-5.4。據大摩研報，該模型爲輕量級新一代，參數7000多億，Preview版已小範圍測試；更強旗艦GLM-5.5參數超3萬億，或12月登場。美國御三家近兩月密集出招、谷歌狀態尤佳，國產陣營下一張牌引發關注。

items_all.title: MiniMax 拿內部模型開刀密碼學：把紙面攻擊變成秒級實戰，NIST 競賽算法首次被真攻破
items_all.summary: MiniMax研究團隊用最新內部模型，對密碼學前沿方案開展系統性自動化密碼分析。模型發現一批此前未公開的算法構造弱點，並將原本停留在論文理論層面的攻擊方式，推進到秒級或分鐘級即可真實執行。這意味着過去需耗費大量人力時間、未必跑得通的攻擊，正被AI自動化顯著加速，密碼學安全評估面臨新變量。

items_all.title: 給 AI 發展劃一條“困惑度”紅線：OpenAI 首席科學家提議設行業門檻
items_all.summary: OpenAI首席科學家帕霍茨基提議，全行業共建AI開發標準，設置硬性安全門檻，企業須承諾滿足安全要求前不越線。方案以“困惑度”等技術指標劃定共同限制，用模型預測下一段文本的能力當安全考卷，防止能力逼近自我加速臨界點。彭博社11月23日報道。

items_all.title: GLM-5.4: Toward Generalized Coding with Our First Loop Transformer
items_all.summary: GLM-5.4: Toward Generalized Coding with Our First Loop Transformer GLM 5.4 is now available from Chinese AI lab Z.ai. It's their first model to use a looped transformer architecture, which they describe like this: In a standard Transformer, each layer runs once per forward pass. In a Loop Transformer, a group of weight-shared layers runs for multiple iterations, refining the hidden states from the previous pass. This gives us a deeper network without increasing the parameter count. This is the second mention of looped transformers I've seen in the past week - the first was Inkling 2 Mini from Thinking Machines Lab on November 20th, who said: Inkling 2 Mini is a looped transformer, running the middle layers of the model three times for every token. This allows the model to apply more reasoning and reach the right answer with fewer tokens, especially on tasks such as agentic coding that depend on reasoning quality. GLM 5.4 is not (yet?) available as open weights. I tried it out using the Z.ai API, for which I had to sign up for their Coding Plan subscription because 5.4 cannot currently be accessed through the regular API. It turns out both coding plan and regular API share the same OpenAI-compatible Responses API (at https://api.z.ai/api/v1 ), and the API key for the coding plan worked with that and gave me access to the new model. I built a llm-glm plugin , then realized that llm-zai by Tommy Hughes already exists! I've shipped mine purely because llm-zai doesn't yet support the new model, but I'll likely retire mine once that plugin catches up. Here are pelicans for GLM-5.
items_all.summary_zh: GLM-5.4：透過我們第一個迴圈 Transformer 邁向廣義編碼 GLM 5.4 現已由中國 AI 實驗室 智譜 提供。這是他們第一個使用迴圈 Transformer 架構的模型，他們對此描述如下：在標準 Transformer 中，每一層在每個前向傳遞中執行一次。在迴圈 Transformer 中，一組權重共用層執行多次疊代，藉此精煉前一次傳遞的隱藏狀態。這讓我們在不增加參數數量的情況下獲得更深層的網路。這是我在過去一週內第二次看到關於迴圈 Transformer 的提及 - 第一次是 11 月 20 日來自 Thinking Machines Lab 的 Inkling 2 Mini，他們表示：Inkling 2 Mini 是一個迴圈 Transformer，為每個 Token 執行模型的中間層三次。這讓模型能夠應用更多推理，並以更少的 Token 達到正確答案，特別是在取決於推理品質的代理式編碼等任務上。GLM 5.4 （目前？）尚未以開源權重形式提供。我使用 智譜 API 進行了試用，為此我必須註冊他們的編碼計畫（Coding Plan）訂閱，因為 5.4 目前無法透過一般 API 存取。結果證明，編碼計畫和一般 API 共享相同的相容 OpenAI 的 Responses API（位於 https://api.z.ai/api/v1 ），而編碼計畫的 API 金鑰適用於該 API 並讓我能夠存取新模型。我建構了一個 llm-glm 外掛程式，然後才發現 Tommy Hughes 已經開發了 llm-zai！我推出自己的外掛程式純粹是因為 llm-zai 尚未支援新模型，但一旦該外掛程式跟進，我可能會讓我的外掛程式退役。以下是 GLM-5 的 pelicans。

items_all.title: Ladybird's first alpha release
items_all.summary: Ladybird is an astonishingly ambitious project: a new browser, in 2026, with its own implementation of most of the key components - HTML parsing, CSS engine, layout, JavaScript, even WebAssembly. It still uses a few external components - things like HarfBuzz for text shaping, Skia for 2D graphics, ffmpeg for video, and SQLite for the things you do with SQLite. Everything else is part of Ladybird, or code brought in from Ladybird's even more ambitious predecessor project SerenityOS . This morning the Ladybird project released their first alpha , which means you can now install the browser (on macOS or Linux) without having to compile it yourself! I've been trying it out today, and it's very impressive. It feels fast, the UI is lightweight and intuitive, and most of the websites I've tried to load in it have worked as they should. I tried Ladybird against several of my more advanced tool examples - like the video-compressor shown above, which runs ffmpeg compiled to WebAssembly. I had it resize its own screenshot using my image-resize tool . It happily runs my Pyodide REPL (Python compiled to WebAssembly) too. items_all.title: RoboTrack: Point tracking for real-world robotic manipulation
items_all.reader_summary: Deploying robots in real-world settings requires reliable perception throughout an interaction. To pick something up, a robot needs to follow the positions of its gripper and the object as they move. In a laboratory, a robot handling a pipette must keep track of its tip while aligning it with the opening of a tube. These tasks become harder when nearby objects clutter the view, the gripper obscures the object being handled, or the viewing angle changes.

items_all.title: datasette-charts 0.1a0
items_all.summary: Release: datasette-charts 0.1a0 I've been thinking about this problem for over a year now, but on Sunday I finally fired up Claude Fable 5.2 to build an initial prototype. The prototype went so well that this is now a full plugin. You can try it out in Datasette Lite here . It looks like this: The new charts plugin works against any table or arbitrary SQL query in Datasette. It defines several different chart types (using vendored D3 , Observable Plot , and topojson-client ), each with a set of heuristics for identifying when they might be a good match for a specific set of rows. Those suggestion thumbnails at the top are actual visualizations driven by the data, and selecting one pulls up the full chart along with tools for modifying it. You can also manually construct a chart from scratch. As with other Datasette visualization plugins, the current state of your chart is persisted in a #fragment in the URL - so you can bookmark charts or share them with others. The most important feature is that the charts take all rows into account . Previous charting plugins like datasette-vega would only show charts for the current page of results, generally up to 100 rows. The new plugin compiles each chart to a SQL query that aggregates across the entire result set (potentially millions of rows) using GROUP BY, time bucketing, and window functions. Each query returns a result capped at 5,000 rows, suitable for display on the chart. The plugin uses sampling to help suggest charts for larger tables without evaluating the full result set. source_material.summary: Release: datasette-charts 0.1a0 I've been thinking about this problem for over a year now, but on Sunday I finally fired up Claude Fable 5.2 to build an initial prototype. The prototype went so well that this is now a full plugin. You can try it out in Datasette Lite here . It looks like this: The new charts plugin works against any table or arbitrary SQL query in Datasette. It defines several different chart types (using vendored D3 , Observable Plot , and topojson-client ), each with a set of heuristics for identifying when they might be a good match for a specific set of rows. Those suggestion thumbnails at the top are actual visualizations driven by the data, and selecting one pulls up the full chart along with tools for modifying it. You can also manually construct a chart from scratch. As with other Datasette visualization plugins, the current state of your chart is persisted in a #fragment in the URL - so you can bookmark charts or share them with others. The most important feature is that the charts take all rows into account . Previous charting plugins like datasette-vega would only show charts for the current page of results, generally up to 100 rows. The new plugin compiles each chart to a SQL query that aggregates across the entire result set (potentially millions of rows) using GROUP BY, time bucketing, and window functions. Each query returns a result capped at 5,000 rows, suitable for display on the chart. The plugin uses sampling to help suggest charts for larger tables without evaluating the full result set. items_all_raw.title: GLM-5.4: Toward Generalized Coding with Our First Loop Transformer
items_all_raw.summary: GLM-5.4: Toward Generalized Coding with Our First Loop Transformer GLM 5.4 is now available from Chinese AI lab Z.ai. It's their first model to use a looped transformer architecture, which they describe like this: In a standard Transformer, each layer runs once per forward pass. In a Loop Transformer, a group of weight-shared layers runs for multiple iterations, refining the hidden states from the previous pass. This gives us a deeper network without increasing the parameter count. This is the second mention of looped transformers I've seen in the past week - the first was Inkling 2 Mini from Thinking Machines Lab on November 20th, who said: Inkling 2 Mini is a looped transformer, running the middle layers of the model three times for every token. This allows the model to apply more reasoning and reach the right answer with fewer tokens, especially on tasks such as agentic coding that depend on reasoning quality. GLM 5.4 is not (yet?) available as open weights. I tried it out using the Z.ai API, for which I had to sign up for their Coding Plan subscription because 5.4 cannot currently be accessed through the regular API. It turns out both coding plan and regular API share the same OpenAI-compatible Responses API (at https://api.z.ai/api/v1 ), and the API key for the coding plan worked with that and gave me access to the new model. I built a llm-glm plugin , then realized that llm-zai by Tommy Hughes already exists! I've shipped mine purely because llm-zai doesn't yet support the new model, but I'll likely retire mine once that plugin catches up. Here are pelicans for GLM-5.
items_all_raw.summary_zh: GLM-5.4：透過我們第一個迴圈 Transformer 邁向廣義編碼 GLM 5.4 現已由中國 AI 實驗室 智譜 提供。這是他們第一個使用迴圈 Transformer 架構的模型，他們對此描述如下：在標準 Transformer 中，每一層在每個前向傳遞中執行一次。在迴圈 Transformer 中，一組權重共用層執行多次疊代，藉此精煉前一次傳遞的隱藏狀態。這讓我們在不增加參數數量的情況下獲得更深層的網路。這是我在過去一週內第二次看到關於迴圈 Transformer 的提及 - 第一次是 11 月 20 日來自 Thinking Machines Lab 的 Inkling 2 Mini，他們表示：Inkling 2 Mini 是一個迴圈 Transformer，為每個 Token 執行模型的中間層三次。這讓模型能夠應用更多推理，並以更少的 Token 達到正確答案，特別是在取決於推理品質的代理式編碼等任務上。GLM 5.4 （目前？）尚未以開源權重形式提供。我使用 智譜 API 進行了試用，為此我必須註冊他們的編碼計畫（Coding Plan）訂閱，因為 5.4 目前無法透過一般 API 存取。結果證明，編碼計畫和一般 API 共享相同的相容 OpenAI 的 Responses API（位於 https://api.z.ai/api/v1 ），而編碼計畫的 API 金鑰適用於該 API 並讓我能夠存取新模型。我建構了一個 llm-glm 外掛程式，然後才發現 Tommy Hughes 已經開發了 llm-zai！我推出自己的外掛程式純粹是因為 llm-zai 尚未支援新模型，但一旦該外掛程式跟進，我可能會讓我的外掛程式退役。以下是 GLM-5 的 pelicans。

items_all_raw.title: Ladybird's first alpha release
items_all_raw.summary: Ladybird is an astonishingly ambitious project: a new browser, in 2026, with its own implementation of most of the key components - HTML parsing, CSS engine, layout, JavaScript, even WebAssembly. It still uses a few external components - things like HarfBuzz for text shaping, Skia for 2D graphics, ffmpeg for video, and SQLite for the things you do with SQLite. Everything else is part of Ladybird, or code brought in from Ladybird's even more ambitious predecessor project SerenityOS . This morning the Ladybird project released their first alpha , which means you can now install the browser (on macOS or Linux) without having to compile it yourself! I've been trying it out today, and it's very impressive. It feels fast, the UI is lightweight and intuitive, and most of the websites I've tried to load in it have worked as they should. I tried Ladybird against several of my more advanced tool examples - like the video-compressor shown above, which runs ffmpeg compiled to WebAssembly. I had it resize its own screenshot using my image-resize tool . It happily runs my Pyodide REPL (Python compiled to WebAssembly) too. items_all_raw.title: RoboTrack: Point tracking for real-world robotic manipulation
items_all_raw.reader_summary: Deploying robots in real-world settings requires reliable perception throughout an interaction. To pick something up, a robot needs to follow the positions of its gripper and the object as they move. In a laboratory, a robot handling a pipette must keep track of its tip while aligning it with the opening of a tube. These tasks become harder when nearby objects clutter the view, the gripper obscures the object being handled, or the viewing angle changes.

items_all_raw.summary: US intelligence agencies tracked contacts between Alice Huang and China's Ministry of State Security for over a year, the New York Times reports. The surveillance ran parallel to her secret affair with then-Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang. Federal investigators are now looking into whether a network of companies in Southeast Asia was used to smuggle AI chips into China in violation of US export controls. Jensen Huang is scheduled to testify before the US House of Representatives on December 1. items_all_raw.title: GPT-6.2 Astra solved a math theorem no other AI could crack, then invented its own proof strategy
items_all_raw.summary: OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra independently produced a machine-verifiable Lean proof of Smoktunowicz's gap theorem, the first of its kind according to Vals AI. The model chose its own approach because key foundations were missing from Mathlib. On Autoform-Hard, Astra now leads the leaderboard with 49 of 56 tasks solved. The article GPT-6.2 Astra solved a math theorem no other AI could crack, then invented its own proof strategy appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra 獨立產出了斯莫克圖諾維奇 (Smoktunowicz) 間隙定理的機器可驗證 Lean 證明，根據 Vals AI 的說法，這是同類中的首創。由於 Mathlib 缺少關鍵基礎，該模型選擇了自己的方法。在 Autoform-Hard 上，Astra 目前以解決 56 個任務中的 49 個領先排行榜。

items_all_raw.title: AI推論供應鏈傳出提示詞外洩，OpenRouter停用3家供應商的服務
items_all_raw.summary: 企業使用AI模型時，送出的提示詞可能經過第三方推論服務供應商處理，一旦供應商遭入侵，提示詞及其中的敏感資訊就可能外洩。工控資安業者Dragos最近公佈研究結果，指出研究團隊利用近200萬筆測試提示詞，發現至少3家AI推論服務供應商遭入侵，其中一起事件的攻擊者甚至取得AWS測試金鑰，並嘗試存取雲端服務。

items_all_raw.title: Fortinet警告AI代理恐成駭客攻擊新目標，提示詞注入可誘使越權操作、誤導SOC事件判斷
items_all_raw.summary: 網路安全業者Fortinet發布2027年資安威脅預測報告，指出隨著企業擴大使用AI代理，駭客可能更積極利用提示詞注入攻擊，誘使AI代理利用原有的存取權限，執行未經授權的操作。其他值得關注的威脅還包括企業付費AI服務遭盜用、AI與自動化工具加快漏洞攻擊準備，以及資安營運中心（SOC）的AI分析系統受到惡意資料誤導。

items_all_raw.title: Mira Murati 團隊把模型“想三遍再說話”開源了：26.4B 循環 Transformer 登頂 Hugging Face，筆記本就能跑
items_all_raw.summary: Mira Murati 的 Thinking Machines Lab 發佈開源權重模型 Inkling2Mini，採用循環 Transformer：24層中，中間12層對每個 token 循環三次，首尾各六層只跑一次。該設計讓模型不生成更多文本也能延長“內部思考”，用更少 token 想清答案，即“多想少說”。此前同系列 Inkling2Small 因 594B 參數被嫌太大。

items_all_raw.title: 把“增長優先”告上法庭：加州總檢察長起訴 OpenAI
items_all_raw.summary: 加州總檢察長羅布·邦塔確認，已於11月16日正式起訴OpenAI，指控其未能確保AI模型安全，將公衆置於風險之中。邦塔在每週通訊中稱，“增長和速度壓倒了安全”，OpenAI把增長與速度置於安全之上，忽視危險信號，未確保模型安全。路透社報道了上述消息。

items_all_raw.title: 微軟揭露GitHub Copilot CLI釣魚攻擊風險，駭客恐藉合法登入程序操控AI代理
items_all_raw.summary: 駭客不必竊取帳號密碼，也可能利用合法的裝置驗證碼登入機制，誘騙開發者核准登入要求，藉此取得OAuth存取權杖。微軟研究發現，這類釣魚攻擊不只可能造成開發資料外洩，在特定條件下，還可能讓攻擊者遠端操控AI代理，在使用者電腦上執行命令。

items_all_raw.title: 說不清的症狀，拍給 AI 看：螞蟻阿福升級實時視頻問診
items_all_raw.summary: 11月23日，螞蟻阿福醫療健康生態大會上，阿福App宣佈升級，基於百靈醫療健康系列模型，主打實時視頻“望聞問切”和全家健康檔案集中管理。用戶可在首頁右下角打開實時音視頻，將鏡頭對準皮膚變化或不適位置，健康排查從打字變爲當面聊，解決“身體不對勁卻說不清”的困擾，讓健康諮詢更直觀。

items_all_raw.title: GLM-5.4 悄然上線 Coding Plan：補齊視覺能力，額度還漲了 1.5 倍
items_all_raw.summary: 智譜GLM-5.4未辦發佈會便上線Coding Plan。官方運營稱，用戶將模型名設爲glm-5.4即可調用，V2、V3及團隊版額度同步提升至1.5倍。新模型詳情暫未公佈，但模型列表已出現“1M”和“視覺”標籤。官方預告顯示，其新增視覺能力，另一項新能力尚未完整披露。此舉被視爲搶先入場。

items_all_raw.title: “歐洲版 OpenAI”落子新加坡：Mistral AI 設亞太總部，替亞洲政府造“主權 AI”
items_all_raw.summary: 法國AI企業Mistral AI宣佈在新加坡設立亞太總部，作爲亞洲根據地。計劃到2027年區域員工擴至200人以上，招募科研、工程、AI及機器人人才。新辦公室以“擴展科學中心”形態運營，核心是爲政府機構和工業客戶開發定製AI模型，聚焦公共部門、高科技製造和機器人三大領域。

items_all_raw.title: 萬億市值換不來投資級：Anthropic 發債大概率是垃圾級
items_all_raw.summary: Anthropic獲股市熱捧，上週募資超1000億美元，估值約1.18萬億美元，超沃爾瑪和摩根大通；但其承諾未來數年投入約9000億美元採購算力，債券市場並不買賬。華爾街預期其債券將定爲垃圾級，評級大概率在BB區間，距投資級差一到兩檔。若成真，它將成爲美國市值最高的高收益債主體，凸顯股債市場分歧。

items_all_raw.title: 螞蟻百靈醫療健康大模型家族全面開源：四款模型各守一關，從看懂體檢報告到攔住醫療風險
items_all_raw.summary: 螞蟻百靈醫療健康大模型家族在螞蟻阿福醫療健康生態大會上宣佈全面開源，一次發佈四款模型：LingSante-3.1-air-VL、LingSante-3.1-flash、LingSante Pulse和LingSante MedGuard，分別覆蓋多模態健康信息理解、複雜醫學推理、健康預測與醫療安全防護。其中air-VL最貼近普通人，支持文字、圖片和視頻理解，可結合皮膚照片、飲食圖片、體檢報告進行綜合分析。

items_all_raw.title: 一個 Slack 線程裏的數學震動：OpenAI 想給 AI 開發裝上限速器
items_all_raw.summary: OpenAI首席科學家雅庫布·帕霍茨基認爲，大模型本質是壓縮器：先建大算力，在無結構數據上訓練壓縮器，再以提示、微調、強化學習激發潛力。衡量進步的核心指標仍是困惑度——預測下一個token的準確度，越低越準。11月22日他發文主張，用這一指標爲前沿模型開發設一道可覈驗的“限速線”。

items_all_raw.title: 谷歌給 Gemini 補上 GIF 生成功能，Omni 1.2 Flash 掌勺、八國免費用戶先用上
items_all_raw.summary: 11月21日，谷歌爲Gemini上線GIF生成功能，由視頻模型Gemini Omni1.2Flash驅動，可生成循環動態圖效和搞笑表情包。用戶只需在對話框描述畫面，片刻即可獲得專屬GIF；也可進入圖像與視頻工具，選擇GIF格式後輸入需求。該功能面向所有Google AI訂閱用戶開放。

items_all_raw.title: COP31未達共識，環境部：加速推動AI成為減碳與氣候調適的新工具
items_all_raw.summary: 聯合國氣候變化綱要公約第31屆締約方大會（COP31）結束後，環境部指出，雖然各國對部分氣候議題仍存在歧見，但全球氣候治理正逐步從國際協商轉向具體行動。對臺灣而言，後續重點除了持續推動減碳政策，也必須回應能源轉型、數位化與AI快速發展所帶來的新挑戰。 其中，AI在今年COP31會議的氣候治理議題逐漸受到重視。過去AI發展經常被視為增加能源需求的新來源，尤其大型模型訓練與推論需要大量運算資源，也帶動資料中心用電成長，全球大舉投入AI資料中心建設，AI資料中心的用電、用水等資源消耗，也引發AIDC的反對聲浪，政府單位先後暫時中止或審慎評估AIDC建置案。

items_all_raw.title: 和 AI 視頻通話問診：螞蟻阿福用戶破 1.5 億，還要往手上戴
items_all_raw.summary: 健康管理正從“治病”轉向“防病”。在廣州舉行的2026螞蟻阿福醫療健康生態大會上，螞蟻CEO韓歆毅判斷：AI對健康最深遠的價值是讓人少生病、少生大病；社會對AI賦能醫療關注多，對AI促進健康的投入明顯不足。上線一年多的螞蟻阿福已是全球最大AI健康應用，麥肯錫測算，若影響健康的因素得到充分管理，將釋放巨大健康價值。

items_all_raw.title: 38 萬參數的 Transformer 塞進一張軟盤：三十年前的 486 老電腦，如今也能“跑 AI”
items_all_raw.summary: 開發者WollyMonjac打造復古項目Tiny2.1，把微型問答Transformer塞進軟盤，讓運行DOS的486DX和Pentium老電腦也能用AI。該軟件用Turbo C 2.0編寫，雖非大型語言模型，卻與當今大模型架構同源，只是被極度壓縮。文中還提到，壓縮難點源於軟盤極其有限的容量。

items_all_raw.title: 沉寂百日後先上前菜：智譜下週發 GLM-5.4，3 萬億旗艦 12 月見
items_all_raw.summary: 國產大模型沉寂三個多月後，智譜被指下週發佈GLM-5.4。據大摩研報，該模型爲輕量級新一代，參數7000多億，Preview版已小範圍測試；更強旗艦GLM-5.5參數超3萬億，或12月登場。美國御三家近兩月密集出招、谷歌狀態尤佳，國產陣營下一張牌引發關注。

items_all_raw.title: MiniMax 拿內部模型開刀密碼學：把紙面攻擊變成秒級實戰，NIST 競賽算法首次被真攻破
items_all_raw.summary: MiniMax研究團隊用最新內部模型，對密碼學前沿方案開展系統性自動化密碼分析。模型發現一批此前未公開的算法構造弱點，並將原本停留在論文理論層面的攻擊方式，推進到秒級或分鐘級即可真實執行。這意味着過去需耗費大量人力時間、未必跑得通的攻擊，正被AI自動化顯著加速，密碼學安全評估面臨新變量。

items_all_raw.title: 微軟 AI 掌門人罕見“交底”：公開 MAI-2 模型關鍵指標，響應 OpenAI 透明度倡議
items_all_raw.summary: 11月22日，AI巨頭罕見相互“交底”。微軟AI CEO蘇萊曼轉發OpenAI首席科學家帕喬茨基文章，明確微軟完全支持OpenAI提高透明度倡議，雙方將共同分享預訓練進展。預訓練數據、方法和進展向來是大模型公司捂得最嚴實的家底，如今被擺上共同公開的桌面，蘇萊曼也順勢作出進一步表態。

items_all_raw.title: datasette-charts 0.1a0
items_all_raw.summary: Release: datasette-charts 0.1a0 I've been thinking about this problem for over a year now, but on Sunday I finally fired up Claude Fable 5.2 to build an initial prototype. The prototype went so well that this is now a full plugin. You can try it out in Datasette Lite here . It looks like this: The new charts plugin works against any table or arbitrary SQL query in Datasette. It defines several different chart types (using vendored D3 , Observable Plot , and topojson-client ), each with a set of heuristics for identifying when they might be a good match for a specific set of rows. Those suggestion thumbnails at the top are actual visualizations driven by the data, and selecting one pulls up the full chart along with tools for modifying it. You can also manually construct a chart from scratch. As with other Datasette visualization plugins, the current state of your chart is persisted in a #fragment in the URL - so you can bookmark charts or share them with others. The most important feature is that the charts take all rows into account . Previous charting plugins like datasette-vega would only show charts for the current page of results, generally up to 100 rows. The new plugin compiles each chart to a SQL query that aggregates across the entire result set (potentially millions of rows) using GROUP BY, time bucketing, and window functions. Each query returns a result capped at 5,000 rows, suitable for display on the chart. The plugin uses sampling to help suggest charts for larger tables without evaluating the full result set. I'm really happy with this initial release of the
